overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the August 23 notice adequately signaled an open session despite the erroneous executive session citation, so the amended-notice timing claim was not reached.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Aug. 31 meeting notice wrongly stated the Board would meet in executive session by citing G.L. c. 30A, §21(a)(1).
allegations.key_passage: We find that the original notice, posted on August 23, satisfied the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the amended notice, which struck the executive session statute reference, was not posted at least 48 hours before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because we find that the notice posted on August 23 satisfied the Open Meeting Law, we need not consider the complainants' allegation that the amended notice was not timely posted.
